'''Kidles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], serving in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] under [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]] during the [[Galactic War]], tasked with providing military supplies to Imperial personnel.<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography== 
Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in between operations,<ref name="vaiken" /> over the course of the [[Galactic War]] Kidles was assigned to several worlds, following [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]]. His assignments included [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="black hole">{{TORcite|type=location|Black Hole|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]],<ref name="X">{{TORcite|type=location|Crag Outpost|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref> [[CZ-198]],<ref name="titans" /> and [[Oricon]],<ref name="oricon" /> before he, along with Major Kantis, got reassigned to [[Darth Marr|Darth Marr]] and joined his forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Revanite crisis]].<ref name="yavin" />

In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> Sergeant Kidles was seen on the [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] [[Ziost Analysis Services Center|orbital station]], treating the wounded who managed to escape from the planet's [[Invasion of Ziost|devastation]]. The fate of Major Kantis, whom he accompanied throughout the war, is unknown.<ref name="ziost">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Ziost Analysis Services Center|Ziost Orbital Station]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Kidles first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Corellia Modification Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock, though he was later relabeled as the Level 52 Modification Vendor, when the Vendor system in the game was changed. Another vendor in the area was also named Sergeant [[Kidles (female)|Kidles]], though she was female and was identical to another vendor named Sergeant [[Jolda (female)|Jolda]]. In order to rectify the duplicates, the female Kidles was renamed as Sergeant [[Kirius]] during the removal of the planetary Equipment Commendation Vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].
